title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1982-04-12

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1982 NY show with stellar Peggy‑O, Birdsong and Sugaree; audience recording is clear and lively though bass a bit low
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the soaring vocals and lyrical Jerry solos on Peggy‑O, Birdsong and Sugaree, plus an inspired second set featuring Estimated, Stella and a raucous encore. The audience tape captures the concert’s excitement with excellent stereo spread and overall clarity, despite a modest bass level in places.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviewers give 4‑5 stars and highlight both an outstanding performance and a very good audience recording; only minor sound issues are noted, yielding a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Superb stereo dynamics and clear capture of vocals and instruments; occasional low‑bass presence and a few minor drop‑outs mentioned, but overall very listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set solid with fun Iko, sweet Peggy‑O and tight LL Rain>Deal; second set ramps up the intensity with Sugaree, Estimated, Stella and a rocking Satisfaction encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as lyrical, sprightly and “one of the most lyrical solos ever”; his tone and vocal delivery on Peggy‑O, Birdsong and Sugaree receive high praise.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for dropping bass bombs and delivering punchy notes; a slight low‑bass level is mentioned but his playing is praised as wild and inventive.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals on Estimated highlighted as terrific and unshowy; no major instrumental comments.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboard work called consummate, professional and tightly locked with Jerry especially on Birdsong.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drummers are said to be “locked from the outset” delivering a solid rhythmic foundation.
